title: Kathmandu traffic sim
subtitle: Mesoscopic peak-hour simulation of Kathmandu on JICA 2011 survey demand
description: Code and inputs for a UXsim simulation of Kathmandu's peak-hour traffic: OpenStreetMap road network (ODbL), peak-hour demand built from the JICA 2011 origin-destination surveys, travel-speed and intersection-count observations, and the scripts for the baseline, seven interventions and a 2030 demand projection. See README.md and the 'Kathmandu traffic 1-5' notebooks.
